tvShows.name: MTV Splitsvilla X6
tvShows.description: Watch MTV Splitsvilla X6 on JioHotstar.

episodes.duration: The boys enter Splitsvilla as Sunny and Karan add a risky twist to their first meets. Vibe checks, dances, and rejections follow until a surprise girl shakes up the game.
The mischief-makers ignite a bomb as jealousy simmers around Mohit. Fights erupt, flirty games begin, and a shocking twist splits the villa into Love and Money.
The Splitsvillians get a dome session notification, sparking excitement. Chaos erupts between Ayush and Diksha, while everyone is thrilled after witnessing their first session.
episodes.episodeName: First Dome Session of the Season!

episodes.duration: Simran steps into Paisa Villa, grabbing attention. The 'Paisa Bolta Hai' game sparks chaos as villamates target each other to protect their stash, leaving low-coin players unsafe.
Couples flex their cute pet names for each other. Sunny and Karan pump them up for the 'Love Charger' challenge to grab the ultimate power.
The Splitsvillians at Paisa Villa get a notification about their first dumping at the Power Chamber. Uorfi reveals that either Vishu or Kaira will hold the power. Who will it be?
The Splitsvillians gather for a high-voltage Dome Session at Pyaar Villa. When Karan and Sunny open the mischief box, a stunning twist reshapes the destiny of an ideal match.
episodes.episodeName: When Fate Twists at Pyaar Villa

episodes.duration: Uorfi shows up in police mode to announce the new 'Looto' challenge for the Paisa Villa couples. Amid chaos, the 'Chor Bachaye More' results reveal the coins secured by each pair.
The Splitsvillians at Pyaar Villa are summoned to the Mischief Den, where Uorfi and Nia ask to choose between pyaar and paisa. Later, Sunny announces the 'Khane Ka Kalesh' challenge.
Nia and Uorfi introduce a tense bidding game where only five Splitsvillians can be saved. However, a shocking twist hands ultimate power to Kaira and Deeptanshu. Who will survive?
episodes.episodeName: New Plots Unfold at Paisa Villa

episodes.duration: As choices between Pyaar and Paisa loom for Splitsvillians, Uorfi and Nia storm the dome with Sunny and Karan, leaving the Splitsvillians on edge. What consequences await them?
episodes.episodeName: Dome of Dilemmas, Pyaar Ya Paisa

episodes.duration: Villas collide in a wild pool party where a massive switch sparks flirty new connections and high-stakes mingling. Will these new pairs be the ideal match?
Nia and Uorfi spill the deets on the 'Seal the Deal' challenge to bag Splitcoins for the Paisa Villa couples. Who'll outplay, outsmart, and vibe with Niharika to snag those sweet coins?
The Dome erupts with accusations, broken connections and rule breaches. A shocking elimination rattles the villa, and a surprise wild card entry flips the game.
Nia and Uorfi spin the Wheel of Power, saving the boys but leaving the girls in a tailspin. Kaira’s shock dump gags the villa and costs her coins!
Excitement peaks at Pyaar Villa during the 'Puppy Lahari' challenge, until a shocking twist grants Anuska immunity, leaving the other contestants on edge. Who will be safe next?
Chaos hits Pyaar Villa as Sadaaf storms at Anuska. Sunny and Nia launch the beachside Paisa Challenge, 'Ball Hai Shava Shava,' and tempers fly as balls go wild!
Romantic Challenge winners light up Pyaar Villa with dreamy dates and Love Den vibes. Meanwhile, in Paisa Villa, Keona's safe play charge sparks a meltdown and shakes the game.
The Power Match gains control to save and dump, shaking the villa. Nia and Uorfi reveal explosive updates from Pyaar Villa, igniting drama and betrayals.
Doom Session takes a dramatic turn as connections flip, and pranks get revealed. Later, Ideal Match Akanksha and Gauresh claim the throne and gain the dumping power.
Secrets spill in a blindfolded task that blurs loyalty and betrayal. Just as chaos brews, Sunny announces a shocking merger that flips the game.
Karan unveils two thrones, one for Pyaar and one for Paisa, while Sunny shuffles the Splitsvillians, igniting excitement for the ultimate challenge at the villa.

episodes.episodeName: Ship Ship Hurray: The Coin Clash

episodes.duration: Tejasswi makes her grand entrance as Karan’s "Ideal Match"! From the high-stakes "Pyaar Ka Atyachar" to coin splits and mini-challenges, the competition just hit a fever pitch.
Dome fights crack connections as eyes turn to the Oracle for the Ideal Match reveal. The mischief-makers reveal the Splitvillians' Paisa Ya Pyaar picks, triggering a lifeline twist
Tensions explode in the villa after betrayal accusations shake alliances. The Jaadu Ki Jhappi challenge sparks intense face-offs as Split-coins begin to shift the power dynamic.
Chaos ensues at the villa after the Split-coin Power Chart reveal, with drama and accusations flying. The vibe shifts as Elvish rolls in with Karan and the red-flag showdown begins.
Karan drops the Tujhe Dhula Diya challenge, and the villa goes on full power mode. The celebration turns chaotic when Anuska calls out Vishu for flipping between the girls.
Tempers flare in the Dome as Sunny calls out Yogesh. Tayne and Sadhaaf turn into an ideal match. Elvish drops a wild mischief that shakes the game and brings Ruru into the villa.
The secret is out and the cake is flying! Karan and Sunny's surprise notification turns the villa into a sugary battlefield as sweet statements lead to bitter confrontations.
Sunny's fiery vibe ignites the villa, but the party ends on an unexpected chill. Hamid drops a shocking twist, the night isn't over, and the real drama is just beginning.
episodes.episodeName: Dance Floor Decoy: The Real Game

episodes.duration: Nia's performance proves the party is just getting started, but the heat rises as Karan and Sunny reveal the top three. The celebration masks a chilling twist. Who will survive?
Situation escalates at the Dome as the Bhaichara beef blows up. Lucky Splitsvillians survive the danger while Akanksha and Gauresh hit the oracle, slaying as the ideal match again!
Kashish stirs chaos in the dome while Suzzane gains power. Sunny unveils the 'Nem Boo Raa' challenge, as players split into teams and battle in an intense showdown.
episodes.episodeName: Nem Boo Raa: Game Heats Up

episodes.duration: Prince's game-changing twist throws a safe couple into danger. As the Paisa Challenge alert erupts, the Villa descends into an all-out battle for coins, power, and survival.
Nia drops the 'Paiso Ki Baarish' bombshell, turning the Villa into a gold mine! But the real storm hits the Dome as Nia and Uorfi prepare to reveal the final Splitscoin count.
The villa is officially on fire! From high-stakes coin doubling to the ultimate romantic validation, the latest Dome session has completely shifted the power dynamics.
episodes.episodeName: Stakes Are Higher, Dares Are Wilder

episodes.duration: Couples battle it out in the electrifying 'Pyaar ka Jhatka' challenge, testing wits and compatibility. Diksha and Himanshu falter, facing crushing disappointment.
Tensions explode during a high-stakes task as rivalries clash. An underdog victory shocks all, but a secret decision and hidden meeting hint at a deeper twist.
Ruru's controversial coin grab propels her to the Power Throne, as Kushal and Kaira triumph as the Ideal Match. A vicious Mischief Box twist triggers shocking eliminations.
Secret tasks ignite chaos and jealousy across the villa. As confrontations explode, shocking penalties and hidden agendas threaten to change the game completely.
In the 'Baby Ko Care Pasand Hai' challenge, boys enjoy beauty care, whereas girls struggle to complete their task. Saboteurs fuel chaos, and an immunity twist sparks clashes.
The Dome session turns into a battleground between Himanshu and Deeptanshu. Amid the chaos, Niharika and Sorab gain power, and an unexpected twist leaves everyone stunned.
Karan's twist doubles Split Coins for Vishu, Tayne, Suzzane, and Ruru. Uorfi's mischief jolts the villa as she unveils the explosive 'Paisa Phek, Tamasha Dekh' challenge.
Gauresh's choice lands him and Akanksha in the unsafe zone. The Splitsvillians brace for a fiery 'Truth or Fair' love test as couples face tough questions that shake their bonds.
Chaos erupts at the Dome as Karan and Sunny reveal their new powers. To save Zalak, everyone must unite and pool their Splitcoins to match the Power Wheel total. Will they succeed?
Sunny Leone introduces contestants who dive into a messy beach boxing task with Digvijay and Hamid. As teams form, romance sparks, and rivalries begin to test trust.
Contestants enter the Dome, where love meets money. Facing elimination, they navigate tasks, bonds, and rivalries, while fashion hampers add excitement and competition.
A high-voltage Dome session sparks dramatic turns as a new ideal match rises. A shocking dumping stuns the villa, as a power card saves one while the disadvantaged get eliminated.
Connections are tested as the Splitsvillans battle for the Ticket to Finale challenge. Friendships crack, betrayals unfold, and only one couple moves closer to the grand finale.
Uorfi spices up the final Dome session. Bonds are shaken and loyalties are tested as tickets outweigh connections, leading to intense drama and emotional, tearful goodbyes.
Karan's twist forces the contestants to pay a steep price in the semi-final challenge, resulting in one couple's elimination. Two strong pairs advance to the grand finale.
Pyaar aur Paise ki jung ab aa chuki hai last stage mein. The Grand Finale is here with a grand challenge and some tempting mischief to shock our finalists!
The Grand Finale is here, and we are serving some khatarnaak khulaase on the Red Carpet. Kisne paaya janta ka pyaar, kisne kiya vaar, aur kaun hoga winner. Watch now!
